title: Berkline Heated Massage Recliners Recalled Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Value City Furniture and American Signature Furniture Stores
summary: The control device that adjusts the heat and massage settings can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Fall Hazard Prompts NHTSA, CPSC and Evenflo to Announce Recall of Embrace™ Infant Car Seat/Carriers
summary: When used as an infant carrier, the handle can unexpectedly release, causing the seat to rotate forward. When this happens, an infant inside the carrier can fall to the ground and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 450,000.

title: Cooper Lighting Emergency Lights Recalled, Could Fail to Illuminate in an Emergency
summary: A circuit board in the light could malfunction, preventing the lights from illuminating in the event of a power failure. This could result in a failure to provide adequate lighting to guide building occupants to an exit in the event of an emergency. Units: About 3,200.

title: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store® Restaurants Recall Rooster Kitchen Stools Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: The stools can unexpectedly collapse during use, causing a consumer to fall to the floor. Units: About 97,000.

summary: Pin-like needles can be embedded in the carpet tiles, posing a puncture wound hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,000 tiles.

title: Halogen Table Lamps Sold at Lowe's Stores Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: These lamps can short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 97,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Glassware Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glassware can crack or break unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 180,000.

title: Battat Inc. Recalls Parents Magazine Toy Cell Phones for Choking Hazard
summary: The metal pin inside the hinge of the cell phone flip-top can fall out, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 14,000.

title: Coast Spas and Franklin Electric Co. Recall Coast Spas Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled spas have a circulating pump and motor assembly, which can overheat and pose a fire hazard. Units: 8000.

summary: The plastic covering on the soft block towers can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 40,000.

summary: The recalled children's necklaces contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 132,000.

title: Payless ShoeSource Recalls Children's Clog Shoes Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Plastic rivets used to attach the strap to the shoe can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 690,000.

title: Target Recalls Anima Bamboo Collection Games Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The toys in the bamboo game sets could contain lead paint, which is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 5,000.

summary: The recalled grills could have an incorrect heat shield that does not fit the grills. Without the correct heat shield, the propane tank, hose, and regulator could overheat and damage these components, presenting a risk of fire and burn to consumers, if a propane leak occurs. Units: About 600.

title: AAFES Recalls "Soldier Bear" Toy Sets Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: Surface paints on the toy action figures contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 3,000.

summary: The seal around the fuel tank can loosen, allowing fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 20,000.

summary: The seam on the bunny's left hind leg can open, exposing a plastic squeaker toy contained inside a cloth bag, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 16,000.

summary: The light sockets on these lamps have a defect, which poses electrical shock and fire hazards. Units: About 1,500.

title: Mervyns Recalls Children's Capri Pants Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Mervyn's Stores
summary: The buttons inside the waistband of the pants can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 228,000.

summary: Liquid rinse-aid can leak from its dispenser onto the dishwasher's internal wiring, which can cause an electrical short and overheating, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2.5 million.

summary: The decorative fish buttons on the shorts and shirt could detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 720.

title: Troy-Bilt Recalls Children's Gardening Gloves Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The stamp-painted logo on the backside of the gardening gloves contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 80.

summary: The recalled rings contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 300,000.

summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 200,000.

title: Children's Metal Jewelry Sold at Limited Too and Justice Stores Recalled by Tween Brands Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The jewelry contains high levels of lead, which can cause adverse health effects and is toxic if ingested by young children. Units: About 103,000.

summary: The swivel, which is attached to a diving regulator, could separate while diving. title: Kayak Paddle Floats Recalled by NRS Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The plastic tubes used to inflate the paddle float could break and deflate, posing a drowning hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,000.

title: Royal Products Recalls Pine Cone Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candle's exterior coating and beads can ignite and catch fire. The fire resulting from the coating and beads on the exterior of the candle could ignite nearby combustibles. Units: About 2,700.

summary: The assembly instructions included with the crib direct consumers to assemble the crib with the mattress support in the highest position and do not indicate that the mattress support can be moved to a lower position. title: Fisher-Price Rainforest Infant Swings Recalled Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: Infants can shift to one side of the swing and become caught between the frame and seat, posing an entrapment hazard. Units: About 112,000 (an additional 15,000 were sold worldwide).

title: K2 Sports Recalls Marker M1 Demo Ski Bindings Due to Unexpected Release, Fall Hazard
summary: Skiers can unintentionally displace a lever at the rear of the binding, which is used for fitting adjustment by ski technicians. If it is fully displaced, it can result in the unexpected release of the binding and possibly cause the user to fall. Units: About 7,400 pairs.

title: Polaris Recalls Select Hawkeye Model ATVs Due to Loss of Control Hazard - Three Crashes Reported
summary: The ATV's front bearing carrier can fail due to an insufficient amount of material thickness in the area where the lower a-arm and ball joint are attached, which can result in a loss of control and a crash and/or serious injury to the operator. Units: About 9,400.

title: Polaris Recalls Select Hawkeye Model ATVs for Steering Post Failure Hazard
summary: The steering posts can break in the area where the handlebar attaches to the steering post. This can result in loss of steering control, resulting in a crash and/or serious injury to the operator. Units: About 8,800.

title: Toy Drums Recalled by The Boyds Collection Ltd. Due to Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The red paint on the drums contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 4,500.
